dateline: In the days after closing the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg with the Sept 6 SoFi Stadium finale, BTS's Los Angeles stand kept generating headlines: RM celebrated an early birthday onstage that night (his actual birthday is Sept 12), and a backstage photo of footballer Son Heung-min with V and Jungkook, shared by RM on Sept 8, went viral. The tour now heads to Latin America, opening in Bogotá on Oct 2.
heroHeadline: Day 4,838: RM's Early Birthday and a Viral Son Heung-Min Photo Cap BTS's LA Stand
heroSubtitle: September 11, 2026 is Day 4,838 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. In the days since closing the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg with the SoFi Stadium finale (Sept 6), two moments from the Los Angeles stand went viral: bandmates and ARMY gave RM an early stadium birthday celebration on Sept 6 — Suga dressed him in a sash and paper crown as fans held up an estimated 26,000 signs — ahead of his actual Sept 12 birthday, and a backstage photo RM shared on Sept 8 of footballer Son Heung-min posing with V and Jungkook (Son had attended the Sept 2 show) spread widely online. The tour now heads to Latin America, opening in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2.
